propositions: Config schema fields can exist with zero read sites, causing the field to silently do nothing at runtime.
An AST-level deterministic check is required to detect schema fields with no attribute-read references outside schema/config plumbing modules.

The check must match terminal-attribute names in Load context (e.g., `.field` segment of `config.section.field`) and reject fields with zero references unless marked with a '# read-via: <pointer>' comment.
The '# read-via:' escape hatch requires a pointer or reason string; bare markers are invalid.
The check must fire only when a field has literally zero read sites, remaining stable across code refactors and generating actionable failure messages that teach the remediation.
